# Naam Thai Cuisine

> > Naam Thai Cuisine is a Thai restaurant serving Madrona, Madison Park, Capitol Hill, and surrounding Seattle neighborhoods with authentic Thai dishes, takeout, delivery, and happy hour specials.

Located in the Madrona neighborhood of Seattle, Naam Thai Cuisine offers online ordering and serves the nearby communities around Lake Washington including Madison Valley, Leschi, Mount Baker, and the Central District.
